# Contract fixtures (copy)

Verbatim copies of `docs/contracts/channel-adapter/fixtures/` from the Soot
repository (`2found/2agent`), contract `channel-adapter.v1` revision v1.1 (§9), digest
`16a8b91eab6fae76` (2agent commit `c935108`). The v1.0 files are unchanged from
digest `7e0f1815a60312d5`; `v1.1-*.json` are new. Soot Forge tests never read a
sibling checkout: when the contract changes, copy the new fixtures here and
update this digest. Fake secrets in `secrets.json` carry the `⟨⟩` split marker.
